description: This file implements the SocketTracker class, which manages and tracks socket lifecycle events, states, and activities within the starboard namespace. It includes methods for socket creation, destruction, connection, binding, acceptance, data transmission, resolution, and logging, utilizing synchronization primitives and maintaining socket state information.

classes.name: SocketTracker
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for tracking socket lifecycle events, states, and activities, providing methods for updating socket status, logging, and analysis.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SocketTracker.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Handles socket creation event, recording initial socket info.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Handles socket destruction, removing it from tracking.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Updates socket state to connected with remote address.

methods.name: OnBind
methods.description: Records local address binding for a socket.

methods.name: OnAccept
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a new socket connection, creating a record for the accepted socket.

methods.name: OnReceiveFrom
methods.description: Updates last activity time and remote address upon receiving data.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Updates last activity time and remote address upon sending data.

methods.name: OnResolve
methods.description: Records hostname resolution for addresses.

methods.name: IsSocketTracked
methods.description: Checks if a socket is currently being tracked.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address associated with a socket.

methods.name: OnListen
methods.description: Marks a socket as listening.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a socket.

methods.name: OnAddWaiter
methods.description: Associates a waiter with a socket for event notification.

methods.name: OnRemoveWaiter
methods.description: Removes the waiter associated with a socket.

methods.name: LogTrackedSockets
methods.description: Logs details of all tracked sockets.

methods.name: ConvertToString_Locked
methods.description: Converts socket address or record to string for logging.

methods.name: ComputeIdleTimePerSocketForThreadId
methods.description: Computes and returns a multimap of idle times and sockets for a specific thread ID.

methods.name: ConvertToString_Locked
methods.description: Converts a socket record to a descriptive string.

methods.name: ComputeTimeIdle
methods.description: Calculates the idle time for a socket record.
